* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 9 October 2026<ref name="ht-rv-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1f401ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Dark/large/runhebvoend.gif runhebvoend.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/1f401ba 1f401ba] (9 October 2026).</ref>, no errata mark. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Run'heb Voend (Errata)]]): PC card image of 11 October 2026<ref name="ht-rv-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/5aa6ad8/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual27-Dark/large/runhebvoend.gif runhebvoend.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/5aa6ad8 5aa6ad8] (11 October 2026).</ref>, no errata mark. While driving a sandcrawler, it moves for free, may not be targeted by weapons, and Run'heb adds one battle destiny. Once during your turn, may choose a player to activate 1 Force.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata). 
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Run'heb Voend (Errata 2)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026). Released with [[Virtual Set 27]] (9 October 2026); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 13 October 2026: “Once per game, may deploy a sandcrawler here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While driving a sandcrawler, it moves for free, may not be targeted by weapons, and Run'heb adds one battle destiny. Once during your turn, may choose a player to activate 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Run'heb Voend (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Run'heb Voend (Errata)]] (published 11 October 2026) as a printable slip under the label “•Run’heb Voend”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
